name: git-bearings
description: A read-only VS Code extension for visualizing Git state and previewing Git commands.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:git-executor && npm run test:core-reader && npm run test:repository-selection && npm run test:supplemental-reader && npm run test:comparison && npm run test:sidebar && npm run test:overview && npm run test:explanation && npm run test:commit-detail && npm run test:command-parser && npm run test:command-simulator && npm run test:git-map && npm run test:command-preview && npm run test:goal && npm run test:refresh && npm run test:hardening
scripts.test:core-reader: npm run compile && node --test out/git/coreRepositoryReader.test.js out/git/p28LocalBranchHistory.test.js
scripts.test:comparison: npm run compile && node --test out/git/branchComparisonReader.test.js out/repository/baseResolver.test.js out/repository/basePreference.test.js out/repository/baseSelection.test.js out/repository/repositoryStateComposer.test.js out/repository/repositoryStateReader.test.js
scripts.test:sidebar: npm run compile && node --test out/ui/repositoryStateSnapshot.test.js out/ui/sidebarPresentation.test.js
scripts.test:overview: npm run compile && node --test out/ui/overviewPresentation.test.js out/ui/overviewHtmlRenderer.test.js
scripts.test:commit-detail: npm run compile && node --test out/git/commitDetailReader.test.js out/ui/commitDetailController.test.js
scripts.test:git-map: npm run compile && node --test out/ui/commitGraphPresentation.test.js out/ui/gitMapPresentation.test.js out/ui/gitMapHtmlRenderer.test.js out/ui/p28GoalJump.test.js out/ui/p28BranchLabelCollision.test.js out/ui/p28RebaseMentalMap.test.js out/ui/gitMapMessage.test.js out/ui/previewClearControl.test.js
